The burgers

People drive in from Rockford, Rochelle and Belvidere for these. Half a pound, fresh, never frozen, cooked a few feet from where you're sitting. Everything comes in a basket with crinkle fries.

The Bloody Mary

It arrives wearing more food than some people order. Bacon, pickle, cheese, sausage, olives. You are welcome to eat the garnish and call it lunch; most people do.

  • Beer on tap Bud Light, Busch Light, and a rotating handle from Prairie State Brewing
  • Bottles and cans Domestics, imports, seltzers

Behind the bar

Same bartenders most nights, which means by your third visit you won't have to say what you're drinking.

The room

Knotty pine from floor to ceiling, neon on every wall, and a Busch Light corn sign that has earned its spot.

Theme nights

Every so often the nets and balloons go up and the kitchen does something out of the ordinary. Facebook is where it gets announced first, usually about a week ahead.
